TASK — byte-identity baseline probe + focus restoration (ADR-0163 cl.10)
nodes.accept: the committed probe asserts serialized-DOM equality of the SPEC fixtures against the pre-diff baseline (exit 0), and a focus-restoration probe passes in Chromium AND WebKit

nodes.label: TASK — the table view pipeline + search/filter state (ADR-0163 cl.2/cl.7)
nodes.accept: a test asserts the normative order filter -> search -> sort -> page over a fixture set, and that empty search/filter are identity (zero stamped anatomy); `npm run check` exits 0

nodes.label: TASK — row selection incl. select-all over the matching set (ADR-0163 cl.4)
nodes.accept: browser probe: select-all under an active filter checks exactly the matching set, header checkbox reads indeterminate when partial, `select` fires once per user commit and never on a programmatic `selected` write

nodes.label: TASK — per-column sort with APG header-button semantics (ADR-0163 cl.5)
nodes.accept: browser probe: activating a sortable header button cycles ascending->descending and reorders rows; `aria-sort` is present on exactly one `<th>`; the computed role of the host table is still `table`

nodes.label: TASK — mint the standalone ui-pagination control (ADR-0163 cl.6)
nodes.accept: `pagination.md` descriptor<->props trip-wire green; probe: `pages<2` renders nothing, the active stop carries `aria-current="page"`, the host announces as a labelled navigation

nodes.label: TASK — table page-size windowing + footer region consuming ui-pagination (ADR-0163 cl.6)
nodes.accept: probe: `page-size=10` over 25 rows renders 10 `<tr>` plus a footer `ui-pagination` with `pages=3` outside the scroll container; pageCount derives from the matching set

nodes.label: TASK — catalog Table widening + Pagination row + feed disposition (ADR-0163 cl.9)
nodes.accept: catalog gates exit 0: the three-slot multi-slot value mark validates on `Table`, the `Pagination` row exists with `FEED_EXCLUDED`, and the feed partition gate is total

nodes.label: TASK — owning-doc repairs: report-family SPEC/LLD, PRD §3 fence, table.md, AND the agent-ui-component-patterns selection row (ADR-0163 Repairs + its Consequences stale-list)
nodes.accept: `site/lib/docs-grammar.test.ts` and `site/lib/adr.test.ts` exit 0; `table.md` frontmatter mirrors `table.ts` static props (descriptor trip-wire green); and the `agent-ui-component-patterns` selection-pattern row states the shipped selection mechanism (ADR-0163 Consequences names it in the stale-list this task discharges)

nodes.label: TASK — entry-data split + the three @agent-ui/app subpaths (ADR-0164 cl.1/cl.2)
nodes.accept: `npm run check` exits 0 with `./entry-list`, `./entry-list.css`, `./entry-data` resolving, every pre-existing `@agent-ui/app` import site compiling unchanged, and no root-barrel name renamed

nodes.label: TASK — entry-list.css re-scope + token repoint + AC19 append (ADR-0164 cl.4)
nodes.accept: the agent-admin visual + computed-style suites pass unchanged (the @scope proximity risk), and the AC19 spacing-drift gate is green with `entry-list.css` in its sheet set

nodes.label: TASK — agent-admin consumes the extraction + standalone mount smoke (ADR-0164 cl.7)
nodes.accept: a new smoke test mounts a styled, working entry section with stub handlers + `createMemoryStore` and zero `ui-agent-admin` in the tree; `entries.test.ts` splits with no assertion lost

nodes.label: TASK — the seeded workbench dataset fixture (the demo's data source)
nodes.accept: the fixture is an in-repo module that type-checks, and a page probe asserts the workbench renders its rows with zero network requests

nodes.label: TASK — the workbench page composed inside ui-workspace-shell
nodes.accept: the page renders in `ui-workspace-shell` and its own sheet declares no shell/layout frame rules (0 bespoke shell CSS, asserted by review + the AC19 gate green on the sheet)

nodes.label: TASK — the filter toolbar driving the table's own search/filter props
nodes.accept: probe: typing in the toolbar search narrows the rendered rows and a facet commit narrows further, with the page never reassigning the table's `rows` prop

nodes.label: TASK — the record-edit form flow (list -> edit -> validate -> save)
nodes.accept: probe: opening a record, entering an invalid value blocks save with a field-level error, and a valid save updates the corresponding table row in place

nodes.label: TASK — the agent-written summary card over the current view
nodes.accept: probe: the card renders agent-authored content describing the current view, and the page contains no bespoke renderer/transport wiring beyond the published seam

nodes.label: TASK — mint the S9 skill-exemplar-path gate (the gate PRD-G5's acceptance depends on)
nodes.accept: `site/lib/docs-grammar.test.ts` carries S9 — walking `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`, extracting backticked repo-relative paths from each table's last cell, existsSync-ing each — proven RED on a planted bogus exemplar path and GREEN on revert, with the pre-existing exemplar corpus (20 paths) passing

nodes.label: TASK — the data-table-toolbar + record-CRUD recipe rows
nodes.accept: both rows exist in `agent-ui-composition-patterns`, each naming an owner ADR id plus an in-repo exemplar path, and S9 is green over them

nodes.label: TASK — the ADR-0164 cl.5 settings-page + resource-list-manager rows
nodes.accept: both rows exist naming ADR-0120/0158 and ADR-0132/0164 as owners with exemplar paths, and S9 is green over them

nodes.label: TASK — the wave's standing gates + size budget line-items
nodes.accept: `npm run check && npm test` exit 0, the six browser shards exit 0, and `npm run size` shows every touched package within budget or a recorded, argued re-base

nodes.label: TASK — the workbench SPEC (this PRD's named follow-on)
nodes.accept: a SPEC exists whose SPEC-R ids each trace to a PRD-G id and which passes `site/lib/docs-grammar.test.ts` (exit 0)

edges.why: the byte-identity baseline must be captured from the pre-widening DOM, so it lands before the first widening diff
select-all and the header checkbox state are computed over the matching set, which only the view pipeline defines
sort is a stage of the normative pipeline; it cannot be positioned before the pipeline exists
the page window always sees the post-filter/search/sort order, so windowing lands on the finished pipeline
the table stamps a ui-pagination in its footer, so the control must exist before the table consumes it
the Table row's multi-slot value mark names selected/select, which must exist before the catalog row can validate
the same mark names sort/change
the same mark names page/change, and pageSize/search/filter join as bindable props
the new Pagination catalog row and its feed disposition need the shipped control's props
the descriptor/SPEC/LLD text states the final shipped surface, so the doc repairs land after that surface stops moving
the sheet is authored against the new folder and its token family, which the split creates
agent-admin re-points its imports at the moved modules
the standalone smoke asserts a STYLED section, which only the re-scoped sheet provides
the composition build is dispatched from a fixed behaviour contract, not from the PRD
the page renders the fixture's rows
the workbench table is selectable
the workbench table is sortable
the workbench table is paginated
the toolbar drives the table's own search/filter props rather than hand-filtering rows
the toolbar docks into the page's content region
the record flow reuses the extracted, consumable entry-list machinery
the edit flow opens from the page's own record list
the summary card occupies a region of the assembled page
the toolbar recipe row documents what the toolbar slice actually built
the record-CRUD recipe row documents what the edit slice actually built
the resource-list row cites the subpath names the split mints
the rows' acceptance predicate IS S9, so the gate must exist before a row can be accepted against it
same — S9 is what proves these rows' exemplar paths resolve
